First Person Melee Controller - Version 1.0.0
=============================

Watch this Tutorial on how to get started: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yC9qaW_RqBU&feature=youtu.be

Thanks for using this asset pack! If you have any feedback, questions, or suggestions,
head down to moonlightgamedevs.com where you can contact us or through the support email,
moonlightgamedevs@gmail.com. There are currated guides and a podcast available as well on
the website as well.

INPUT ERROR: This asset comes with an input system that is designed to work with gamepads as
well as the keyboard and mouse interchangeably. That is why a InputManager.asset file is included, which
contains the necessary input configuration. Go to the folder YourProject/ProjectSettings of your project 
and replace the InputManager.asset file there with the one from this pack.

Follow me on Twitter to see what cool stuff I'm building next!
https://twitter.com/MarcBeaujean

The asset pack is based on the Unity FPS Demo, available here: http://u3d.as/1E4y
